Definition: Minjamin, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Minjamin is the name of two Israelites, both priests of the later years. One stands in the courses of the priests after the return, and the other helps distribute the offerings under Hezekiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name is kept because the work was kept: the courses of the priests and the sharing of the offerings both needed faithful men, and Minjamin was one of them.
